title: Task Scheduler
statement: Given a list of tasks and a cooldown period `n`, compute the minimum number of intervals needed to finish all tasks. Idle intervals can be inserted between tasks of the same type.
constraints:
- `1 <= tasks.length <= 10^4`
- `tasks[i]` is uppercase English letter
- `0 <= n <= 100`

examples.input:
6 2
A A A B B B

6 0
A A A B B B

hints: Count task frequencies.
max_freq = highest frequency.
Result = max(total_tasks, (max_freq-1)*(n+1) + count_of_max_freq_tasks).
